plan.title: SHG Loan Repayment and Purpose Analysis
plan.subtitle: Key metrics on loan repayment status and purpose distribution across blocks

panels.title: Total SHG Loans Disbursed
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM shg_loan_register

panels.title: Loans Overdue (%)
panels.sql: SELECT ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN "Repayment Status" = 'Overdue' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 1) AS n FROM shg_loan_register

panels.title: Average Loan Amount (Rs)
panels.sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG("Loan Amount (Rs)"), 0) AS n FROM shg_loan_register

panels.title: Repayment Status by Block
panels.sql: SELECT "Block", COUNT(*) AS n FROM shg_loan_register GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Loan Purpose Distribution
panels.sql: SELECT "Purpose", COUNT(*) AS n FROM shg_loan_register GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Top 5 Blocks by Overdue Loans
panels.sql: SELECT "Block", COUNT(*) AS overdue_count FROM shg_loan_register WHERE "Repayment Status" = 'Overdue' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 5

panels.title: Average Loan Amount by Purpose
panels.sql: SELECT "Purpose", ROUND(AVG("Loan Amount (Rs)"), 0) AS avg_amount FROM shg_loan_register GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC
